boundary_verification.subject: Codex native filesystem and rendered input
boundary_verification.method: Pinned standalone 0.154.0; fresh canonical HOME/CODEX_HOME/workspace outside checkout; minimal read/workspace write profile and explicit native customization disables.
boundary_verification.observed: Native probe wrote inside workspace and denied sibling private-file access. Configured prompt had no default Skill, multi-agent or development markers; auth-only copy reported ChatGPT while sandbox denied auth.json and repository AGENTS.
boundary_verification.limit: Native probe/input inspection is separate from model execution; actual applications are recorded in the trial files.

boundary_verification.subject: Read-only grading
boundary_verification.method: Evaluator-only instructions and native read-only workspace, after excluding a judge that wrote a replacement workbook.
boundary_verification.observed: Probe read the reference spreadsheet through openpyxl and denied replacement creation. Corrected GDPval re-evaluation preserved the original artifact hash.

boundary_verification.subject: Claude subscription file-tool route
boundary_verification.method: Safe/restricted mode with fresh configuration, transient OAuth-only credentials and selected Skill bodies supplied explicitly; bare mode was rejected because it excludes OAuth/keychain authentication.
boundary_verification.observed: User login and isolated-copy checks reported claude.ai/firstParty/Max. Actual GSM8K used the exact Sonnet4.6 model with Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep; anonymous judges exposed Read/Glob/Grep.
boundary_verification.limit: No shell-isolation claim for re-enabled Bash. GDPval office execution/judging is rejected for this Claude route.

settled_setup_findings: The initial Codex profile missed the uv minor-version symlink. A native probe reproduced the denial; interpreter-namespace read access fixed openpyxl imports without changing model or billing route.

iCloud UF_HIDDEN flags caused Python3.13 to skip editable .pth imports. Noneditable locked installation was verified for users and fresh checkout; PYTHONPATH=harness/src is available for source development. Global settings were unchanged.

Five development Skills were exposed in the host catalog; Claude aliases resolved, but native Claude development-Skill discovery was not claimed as verified. Participants use explicit selected Skill delivery with ambient discovery disabled.

retained_input_acquisition.grading_input_boundary: Rubric withheld from participant; prompt and reference spreadsheet supplied.

reuse_and_adaptation.decision: Execute unchanged data preparation, including its existing answer fixes; verified 1,319 rows and source hash above.
Use retained public task/reference/rubric fields. Harness normalization keeps answer-bearing snapshots outside participants.
Adapt its task/reference-file staging boundary; public files are acquired separately so preflight remains read-only. Native CLI workspaces replace container/server assumptions.

Adapt the existing JSONL CLI execution, temporary-home, timeout/process-group and stream-recording patterns. Its Gym provider config injects OPENAI_API_KEY and bypasses login; that path cannot be the required subscription route.

Adapt per-call configuration and stream usage collection. Its API environment, skip-permissions and optional bare/native-discovery behavior are incompatible with the measured account/isolation requirements. Exact pinned CLI probes determined the new confined invocation.

Preserve the Agent Skills frontmatter, content-hash provenance and file staging concepts. The local adapter stages only explicitly selected bodies/references; native discovery would expose ambient Skills in the actual probe.

Adapt the final-answer/boxed convention into a bounded non-executing numeric/string grader. No arbitrary submission expression or candidate code execution. Formatting edge regressions and actual saved answers verify this local diagnostic grader; it is not an official score claim.

Preserve rubric-scoring and anonymous A/B/tie concepts. Direct model client calls and office conversion/server setup are not mandatory. New CLI judges inspect immutable saved artifacts; both presentation orders are scheduled.

Retain upstream commands for upstream environments; the six requested local commands use the same task-to-artifact-to-judgment boundary, with new durable local journals for frozen resume and no API/server dependency.

new_responsibilities: Six-command contract, account-only runtime policy, independently frozen creation/application/grading inputs, append-preserving journals, human entry and method-separated aggregation.

real_trial_calls.note: Includes retained excluded/corrective trials; no quality ranking inferred. Native no-model probes and authentication checks are separate.

usage_constraints: Live verification on macOS with standalone Codex0.154.0 and Claude2.1.270; Luna medium and Sonnet4.6 medium.
Claude GDPval office application/judging rejected before execution; use Codex.
Serial execution (concurrency1); choose bounded tasks/repeats/retries/timeouts explicitly.
Unavailable cost is null; Claude reported USD is an API-equivalent estimate, not subscription billing.
Human evaluation acceptance uses explicitly synthetic fixture ratings, not real human quality judgments.
Small functional comparisons are neither official benchmark scores nor evidence of ALPS superiority.

artifact_availability.committed: Acceptance records, selected answers, judgments, synthetic human ratings, hashes and immutable links to original full records.
artifact_availability.local_only: Original workbooks, complete CLI logs, prompts/config snapshots and audit outputs remain under recorded runs/ and .audit/ paths; cleanup does not move or regenerate them.
artifact_availability.path_base: All relative local paths are relative to the originating repository checkout unless a record explicitly states another base.
artifact_availability.limitation: Local paths and hashes do not make raw files retrievable to another checkout. No independently downloadable raw-artifact bundle is recorded. Historical full record URLs include precommit source hashes omitted from compact records.
